name: upstream-evidence-and-action-identity-migration

checks.name: semantic producer consumes acquired source evidence
semantic producer no longer discovers or reads source files
source acquisition owns filesystem discovery and reads
source evidence is represented by a closed typed contract
action identity resolution has a closed upstream contract
upstream authority resolves duplicate action names independent of input order
CLI delegates final action identity to upstream authority
CLI projection no longer mints duplicate suffixes
upstream barrel exports both migration contracts
route lookup rejects missing upstream identity

residuals: The semantic producer still parses acquired PHP syntax; parser construction and semantic judgment production remain coupled.
The source evidence acquisition contract currently covers models, resources, controllers and services; other Laravel source families retain their existing scanner paths.
Full TypeScript typecheck, build and end-to-end Laravel fixture verification require project dependencies that are absent from this workspace.
Dataflow/relational-calculus authority audits remain separate unresolved migrations.
